plugins.name: jihan-agents
plugins.description: Role-based agent suite for documentation lifecycle. Bundles 6 role agents (notion-writer, verifier-on-sandbox, notion-doc-verifier, notion-verifier-gui, notion-verifier-concept, doc-librarian) and 2 skills (general-doc-rules, method-doc-rules) for authoring, verifying, QAing, and cataloging documentation. doc-librarian ships a SessionStart scan hook for tiered doc upkeep.
